description.en: Returns the game version, straight from CMND_GET_GAME_VERSION(). The scripts compare it with GAME_VER_DR and GAME_VER_SH (the two editions of the game) to run edition-specific story branches.
The value returned by CMND_GET_GAME_VERSION (GAME_VER_DR or GAME_VER_SH).

examples.case: An edition-specific map jump (real usage, from ev42022200.nut)
